The '''Tasbir''' was an [[Alwari]] clan that was part of the [[Southern Hatagai]]. Its outcast members included the "clanless" [[Kyakhta]] and [[Bulgan]].<ref name="AS">''[[The Approaching Storm]]''</ref>
